static_traits.name: Tan Haili
static_traits.occupation: Working in the automobile manufacturing industry
static_traits.social_status: Keeping distance from financially stable friends, reduced socializing; has a few friends and colleagues to confide in but feels uncomfortable talking about finances
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; has not received psychotherapy before; no history of similar problems
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly organized; able to cooperate and restructure cognitions; positive attitude; able to identify evidence and alternative views

basic_info.main_problem: I keep feeling that with an annual income of 30k I can never afford a house, which makes me feel despair and dissatisfaction.
basic_info.core_demands: The overwhelming despair and dissatisfaction caused by the financial situation affect daily life and mental health; hoping counseling will ease and improve it.
growth_experiences: After starting to consider owning a house a few years ago, the thought 'buying a house is almost impossible' arose based on a 30k annual income; triggered almost daily when seeing real estate advertisements or when friends talk about their investments; the problem gradually worsened as peers progressed and made big purchases; although budgeting and researching affordable listings were tried, there was no significant relief; as a result work performance was affected, and feeling not good enough in front of financially stable friends led to active distancing; living alone, even talking about financial topics feels uncomfortable.

core_beliefs: My income is destined to be insufficient for the home-buying goal
I am financially worse off than others, appearing not good enough

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If house prices are high and my annual income is only 30k, buying a house is impossible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids paying attention to advertisements, or instead makes budgets and researches cheaper housing to seek a sense of control
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 30k is never enough; buying a house is impossible for me

special_situations.event: Talking with friends about their investments or home purchases
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my financial situation is worse than my friends', it shows I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Staying away from financially stable friends, reduced socializing to avoid inferiority and being compared
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am worse than they are; I look bad in front of them

special_situations.event: Seeing peers progress and make big purchases
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my income is only 30k now, I will keep lagging behind and never catch up with them
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Worsening worries about insufficient income, avoiding contact with peers
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never catch up with them

special_situations.event: Reading reports or data about housing prices
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Even if there are cheaper areas or fixer-uppers, these are not realistic for me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuously attends to high-price information, ignoring potentially feasible paths
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: House prices are too high; any effort is useless

core_conflict.wish: Longs to own one's own house and a sense of financial stability, and to be accepted and recognized among peers
core_conflict.fear: Fear of never being able to achieve the home-buying goal, of being seen as lagging behind or not good enough
defense_goal: Distances from financially stable friends to avoid inferiority and comparison
Gaining a sense of control and easing anxiety through budgeting and researching affordable listings
Stays cautious when facing property information to reduce emotional fluctuation

object_relations.self_representation: A laggard who is not good enough
object_relations.object_representation: Successful peers who might judge me

manifestations: Feels income limits life choices and the possibility of buying a home
Experiencing helplessness when seeing property advertisements or data
Actively distancing because of feeling not good enough in front of financially stable friends
Living alone and feeling uncomfortable talking about financial topics

positive_force: Trying to budget and research affordable listings
Able to identify and consider alternative paths such as cheaper areas or fixer-uppers
Has some social support (a few friends and colleagues)
negative_force: Persistent financial worries and negative anticipation
Comparing with peers leads to inferiority and social avoidance
Cognitive distortions exist (Mental Filtering / Disqualifying the Positive / Overgeneralization).
Decline in work performance, further increasing stress

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent negative automatic thoughts and worries around income and buying a house
antecedent: Talking with friends about their investments or home purchases
target_behavior.core_reason: Worries about the future financial situation and high house prices, forming the belief of 'never enough' after comparing with peers
target_behavior.function: Avoiding uncertainty and failure risks, gaining a brief sense of mental control through negative anticipation
target_behavior.consequence: Increased hopelessness and dissatisfaction, worsened anxiety, decreased life satisfaction

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance (distancing from financially stable friends)
antecedent: In contact with financially stable friends or hearing about their investments
Seeing others buy property or major items
target_behavior.core_reason: Feeling not good enough and ashamed in front of others, fearing comparison and judgment
target_behavior.function: Evades shame and inferiority feelings, reducing comparison triggers
target_behavior.consequence: Loneliness and reduced social support, negative emotions persisting or worsening

target_behavior.behavior: Decline in work performance (attention occupied by financial worries)
antecedent: Thinking about finances and home-buying at work
Entering work scenarios after being triggered by property-related information
target_behavior.core_reason: Persistent repeated worry occupies cognitive resources, emotional load too high
target_behavior.function: Temporarily easing anxiety and cognitive load by reducing task engagement
target_behavior.consequence: Performance declines, stress increases further, forming a negative cycle
